# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m p2pac.config --markdown > docs/configuration.md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every option can be set in three ways (later wins): the method preset (`--method`), a YAML file (`--config file.yaml`, keys written with underscores, e.g. `t_p: 100000`), or a command-line flag (dashes, e.g. `--t-p 100000`). Yes/no options are switched with `--flag` / `--no-flag`.

The column **Paper** says where the paper states the value. An empty cell means the paper does not state it; such values should be reported in the paper or its supplement.

## Methods and their presets

| `--method` | What it runs | Values it sets |
|---|---|---|
| `p2p` | P2P-AC, the method of the paper (with --algo sac, td3 or ddpg) | `planner=reap`, `execute_planner=on`, `buffer=dual`, `imitation_space=logit`, `buffer_size=2 000 000`, `planner_buffer_capacity=1 000 000` |
| `base` | the RL algorithm alone, without planner (with --algo sac, td3, ddpg or ppo) | `planner=none`, `buffer=single`, `kappa0=0`, `execute_planner=off`, `buffer_size=1 000 000`, `t_p=0`, `t_d=0` |
| `accel` | Accelerated SAC baseline: the policy acts, the planner only provides imitation labels (--algo sac) | `planner=reap`, `execute_planner=off`, `buffer=single`, `imitation_space=action_sample`, `label_noise_std=0.01`, `t_p=100 000`, `t_d=50 000`, `kappa0=10`, `buffer_size=1 000 000` |
| `bc` | behaviour cloning of the planner actions collected by a P2P-AC run (needs --bc-data) | `planner=none` |
| `planner` | the planner acting alone (reference row of Table II, estimates of q and K) | `planner=reap` |

## Run management

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--experiment` | `default` |  | Experiment group; the first directory level under --output-root (e.g. main, ablation). |
| `--variant` | '' |  | Optional tag appended to the run name, e.g. 'budget_5' or 'single_buffer'. Use it whenever you change an option, so the run gets its own directory. |
| `--seed` | 0 |  | Random seed of the run (network initialisation, exploration, training start states, simulator). |
| `--output-root` | `runs` |  | Root directory of all run directories. |
| `--run-dir` | – |  | Explicit run directory (overrides the automatic <output_root>/<experiment>/<name>/seed_<k>). |
| `--resume` | `auto` |  | What to do if the run directory already exists. auto: continue an unfinished run from its last checkpoint and skip a finished one; never: refuse to use an existing directory; must: fail if there is no checkpoint. Choices: `auto`, `never`, `must`. |
| `--allow-config-change` / `--no-allow-config-change` | off |  | Allow resuming a run with a different configuration (the change is recorded). |
| `--force-new` / `--no-force-new` | off |  | Start a fresh attempt even if a finished run exists. It is written next to the old one (<name>__rerun_<time>); nothing is overwritten. |
| `--total-steps` | 5 000 000 | Fig. 2 (x-axis) | Training budget in environment steps. |
| `--learner-device` | `auto` |  | PyTorch device of the learner: auto, cpu or cuda:0. (The Isaac Sim device is set separately with Isaac Lab's --device flag.) |
| `--notes` | '' |  | Free text stored in the run's manifest. |

## Simulator

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--backend` | `isaac` | Sec. VI-A | Simulator. isaac: Unitree Go2 in NVIDIA Isaac Lab (all paper experiments). kinematic: a simple numpy model of the robot, only for testing the code on a laptop. Choices: `isaac`, `kinematic`. |
| `--num-envs` | 1 |  | Number of parallel environments (the Isaac backend supports 1). |
| `--locomotion-checkpoint` | – |  | Frozen locomotion policy (RSL-RL checkpoint). Default: assets/locomotion_policy/Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Unitree-Go2-v0/checkpoint.pt. |
| `--isaac-episode-length-s` | – |  | Isaac Lab's internal episode length in seconds. Default: longer than T_max, so Isaac never ends an episode by itself (episodes are ended by the navigation task). |
| `--locomotion-obs-noise` / `--no-locomotion-obs-noise` | on |  | Keep the observation noise of the frozen locomotion policy (Isaac Lab's default for this task). |
| `--spawn-height` | 0.5 |  | Height (m) at which the robot is placed at the start of an episode. |
| `--contact-threshold` | 1 |  | Contact force (N) on the trunk above which the episode ends as a crash. |
| `--video` / `--no-video` | off |  | Record videos of training episodes (Isaac only; slows training down). |
| `--video-every` | 500 000 |  | Record a video every this many environment steps. |
| `--video-length` | 2 000 |  | Length of each video in environment steps. |
| `--kin-tau` | 0.1 |  | Kinematic test model only: time constant (s) of the velocity response. |
| `--kin-vel-noise` | 0.01 |  | Kinematic test model only: standard deviation (m/s) of the velocity noise. |
| `--kin-yaw-noise` | 0 |  | Kinematic test model only: standard deviation (rad/s) of the heading noise. |

## Task (Sec. VI-A)

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--obs-mode` | `paper` | Eq. (18) | State given to the policy. paper: [x, y, x_goal, y_goal] (Eq. 18). extended: additionally cos/sin of the heading and the body velocity (not used in the paper). Choices: `paper`, `extended`. |
| `--vx-max` | 0.7 | Sec. VI-A | Action bound (m/s) of the forward velocity command v_x. |
| `--vy-max` | 0.7 | Sec. VI-A | Action bound (m/s) of the lateral velocity command v_y. |
| `--yaw-hold-gain` | 0 |  | Gain of an optional heading controller (0 = off: yaw-rate command 0, as in the paper). |
| `--goal` | 0 2.8 | Sec. VI-A | Goal position x y (m). |
| `--goal-tolerance` | 0.3 | Sec. VI-A | The episode ends in the goal set G when the robot is closer than this (m) to the goal. |
| `--arena` | -2 2 -2 3.5 | Sec. VI-A | Arena bounds x_min x_max y_min y_max (m). |
| `--wall-margin` | 0.35 |  | The robot centre must stay this far (m) from the arena bounds; closer counts as a failure. |
| `--obstacles` | 0 0.15 0.23 -1.3 0.75 0.23 0 1.45 0.23 1.3 0.75 0.23 1.3 -0.45 0.23 -1.3 -0.45 0.23 | Sec. VI-A | Cylindrical obstacles as a flat list x1 y1 r1 x2 y2 r2 ... (m). |
| `--robot-radius` | 0.3 |  | Planar radius (m) of the robot trunk used for collision checking. |
| `--leg-reach-margin` | 0.02 |  | Extra collision margin (m) for the legs. |
| `--fall-height` | 0.1 | Sec. VI-A | The episode ends as a fall when the trunk is lower than this (m). |
| `--max-episode-steps` | 8 000 | Sec. VI-A | Maximum episode length (steps of 0.02 s); the episode is truncated after it. Symbol: T_max. |
| `--spawn-y-max` | 0 |  | Start positions are drawn with y <= this value (the lower part of the arena). |
| `--spawn-clearance` | 0.5 |  | Start positions keep at least this extra distance (m) from every obstacle. |
| `--spawn-yaw-deg` | 90 |  | Initial heading of the robot (degrees; 90 = facing +y). |
| `--step-cost` | 1 | Sec. VI-A | Cost paid at every step. Symbol: w_s. |
| `--action-cost` | 0.02 | Sec. VI-A | Weight of the control-effort cost ||u||^2. Symbol: w_u. |
| `--goal-reward` | 100 | Sec. VI-A | Reward for reaching the goal. Symbol: r_G. |
| `--failure-cost` | 200 | Sec. VI-A | Cost of a failure (collision, leaving the arena, fall). Symbol: r_F. |

## Planner (Sec. IV, VI-A)

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--planner` | `reap` | Sec. IV | Planner used by p2p, accel and planner runs (none = no planner). Choices: `reap`, `none`. |
| `--planner-horizon` | 15 | Sec. VI-A | Prediction horizon (steps). Symbol: N. |
| `--planner-dt` | 0.02 | Sec. VI-A | Sampling time (s) of the planner's model z+ = z + dt u. |
| `--planner-vmax` | 0.5 | Sec. VI-A | Bound (m/s) on each component of the planner's velocity. |
| `--planner-q` | 1 |  | State weight of the MPC cost. |
| `--planner-r` | 0.5 |  | Input weight of the MPC cost. |
| `--planner-terminal-cost` | `dare` |  | Terminal weight: dare = solution of the discrete Riccati equation; q = same as the state weight. Choices: `dare`, `q`. |
| `--reap-beta` | 100 | Sec. VI-A | Barrier parameter beta of the modified barrier function (Eq. 13). Symbol: beta. |
| `--reap-omega` | 200 |  | Parameter omega of the modified barrier function (Eq. 13); must be larger than beta. Symbol: omega. |
| `--reap-step` | 1 |  | Step size of the primal update (with backtracking, see docs/planner_validation.md). |
| `--reap-dual-step` | 0.05 |  | Step size of the dual (multiplier) update. |
| `--reap-iterations` | 20 |  | Computation budget: iterations of the primal-dual flow per planner query. Symbol: t_cpu. |
| `--reap-time-budget-ms` | – |  | Optional extra wall-clock cap (ms) per query. Off by default because it makes runs machine dependent. |
| `--reap-init` | `cold` |  | Initial point of each query. cold: u = 0 (Assumption 1). warm: the shifted previous solution when it is feasible. Choices: `cold`, `warm`. |
| `--reap-lambda-init` | 0.01 |  | Initial value of every dual variable. |
| `--reap-armijo` / `--no-reap-armijo` | on |  | Require a sufficient decrease of the barrier function in the primal step. |
| `--reap-dual-update` | `gauss_seidel` |  | Dual update at the new primal iterate (gauss_seidel) or at the old one (jacobi = plain forward Euler). Choices: `gauss_seidel`, `jacobi`. |
| `--planner-obstacle-margin` | 0.05 |  | Extra distance (m) the planner keeps from obstacles beyond the collision radius. |
| `--planner-wall-margin` | 0.05 |  | Extra distance (m) the planner keeps from the walls beyond --wall-margin. |
| `--planner-walls` / `--no-planner-walls` | on | Sec. VI-A | Include the arena walls in the planner's constraints. |
| `--planner-heading-deg` | – |  | Heading (degrees) used to convert the planner's world-frame velocity into the body-frame command. Default: --spawn-yaw-deg. |

## P2P-AC (Sec. V)

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--t-p` | 100 000 | Sec. VI-B | Planner phase length: for t < T_p the planner chooses the executed actions. Symbol: T_p. |
| `--t-d` | 50 000 |  | Transition length: the imitation weight decays linearly to 0 between T_p and T_r = T_p + T_d. Symbol: T_d. |
| `--kappa0` | 10 | Sec. VI-B | Initial imitation weight (constant until T_p). Symbol: kappa_0. |
| `--execute-planner` / `--no-execute-planner` | on |  | The planner chooses the executed actions for t < T_p (--no-execute-planner = ablation 'without planner phase'). |
| `--imitation-space` | `logit` | Sec. V-C | Imitation loss. logit: Eq. (19), in the pre-tanh space (paper). action: on the deterministic action (ablation). action_sample: on the sampled action (Accelerated SAC). Choices: `logit`, `action`, `action_sample`. |
| `--logit-clip-eps` | 0.0001 |  | Clipping epsilon before artanh in the logit target (Eq. 18). Symbol: epsilon_c. |
| `--label-noise-std` | 0 |  | Gaussian noise (m/s) added to the imitation targets (used by Accelerated SAC). |
| `--buffer` | `dual` | Sec. V-B | Replay buffer. dual: protected planner buffer D_P plus FIFO buffer D_O, each minibatch half from each (paper). single: one FIFO buffer. Choices: `dual`, `single`. |
| `--planner-buffer-capacity` | 1 000 000 | Sec. VI-B | Capacity of the protected planner buffer D_P (must be >= T_p). Symbol: C_P. |
| `--planner-batch-fraction` | 0.5 | Sec. V-B | Fraction of every minibatch drawn from D_P. |

## RL algorithm

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--learning-rate` | 0.0003 | Sec. VI-B | Adam learning rate of all networks. |
| `--buffer-size` | 1 000 000 | Sec. VI-B (P2P-AC: 2e6) | Total replay capacity C (for the dual buffer: D_O holds C - C_P). Symbol: C. |
| `--learning-starts` | 100 |  | Number of steps collected before the first gradient update. |
| `--batch-size` | 256 |  | Minibatch size. Symbol: n_b. |
| `--tau` | 0.005 |  | Polyak coefficient of the target networks. |
| `--gamma` | 0.99 |  | Discount factor. Symbol: gamma. |
| `--train-freq` | 1 |  | Environment steps between two training phases. |
| `--gradient-steps` | 1 |  | Gradient updates per training phase. |
| `--net-arch` | 256 256 | Sec. VI-B | Hidden layer sizes of the actor and the critic. |
| `--activation` | `relu` | Sec. VI-B | Activation function of the hidden layers. Choices: `relu`, `tanh`, `elu`. |
| `--adam-eps` | – |  | Adam epsilon. Default: the Stable-Baselines3 default of each algorithm (1e-8 for SAC/TD3/DDPG, 1e-5 for PPO). |
| `--ent-coef` | `auto` |  | SAC entropy coefficient: 'auto' (learned), 'auto_0.1' (learned, initial value 0.1) or a number. |
| `--target-entropy` | – |  | SAC target entropy for ent_coef=auto. Default: -dim(action) = -2. |
| `--exploration-noise` | 0.1 |  | TD3/DDPG: standard deviation of the Gaussian exploration noise, in normalised action units ([-1, 1]). |
| `--td3-policy-delay` | 2 |  | TD3: critic updates per actor update. |
| `--td3-target-noise` | 0.2 |  | TD3: standard deviation of the target policy smoothing noise. |
| `--td3-target-noise-clip` | 0.5 |  | TD3: clipping of the target policy smoothing noise. |
| `--ppo-n-steps` | 2 048 |  | PPO: steps per rollout. |
| `--ppo-batch-size` | 64 |  | PPO: minibatch size. |
| `--ppo-n-epochs` | 10 |  | PPO: epochs per rollout. |
| `--ppo-gae-lambda` | 0.95 |  | PPO: GAE lambda. |
| `--ppo-clip-range` | 0.2 |  | PPO: clipping range. |
| `--ppo-ent-coef` | 0 |  | PPO: entropy bonus. |
| `--ppo-vf-coef` | 0.5 |  | PPO: value-loss weight. |
| `--ppo-max-grad-norm` | 0.5 |  | PPO: gradient-norm clipping. |

## Behaviour cloning baseline

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bc-data` | – |  | Run directory of a finished P2P-AC run (its artifacts/planner_buffer.npz is used) or the path of a planner_buffer.npz file. |
| `--bc-epochs` | 50 |  | Training epochs. |
| `--bc-batch-size` | 256 |  | Minibatch size. |
| `--bc-lr` | 0.0003 |  | Adam learning rate. |
| `--bc-val-fraction` | 0.1 |  | Fraction of the data held out to select the best epoch. |
| `--bc-loss` | `action` |  | Regression target: action (MSE on actions) or logit (Eq. 19). Choices: `action`, `logit`. |

## Evaluation (Sec. VI-C)

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--eval-every` | 100 000 |  | Evaluate the policy every this many environment steps. |
| `--eval-episodes` | 20 |  | Episodes per periodic evaluation (always the same start positions). |
| `--eval-seed` | 1 000 003 |  | Seed of the evaluation start positions (identical for all methods and seeds). The final evaluation uses eval_seed + 1. |
| `--eval-at-start` / `--no-eval-at-start` | on |  | Also evaluate the untrained policy at t = 0. |
| `--eval-final-episodes` | 100 |  | Episodes of the final evaluation of the final policy (Table II). |
| `--save-eval-trajectories` / `--no-save-eval-trajectories` | on |  | Save the xy trajectories of evaluation episodes (for figures). |

## Logging and checkpoints

| Flag | Default | Paper | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--log-steps` | `all` |  | all: log every environment step to logs/steps/*.npz; none: do not. Choices: `all`, `none`. |
| `--step-log-chunk` | 50 000 |  | Environment steps per step-log file. |
| `--learner-log-every` | 1 000 |  | Write learner statistics every this many gradient updates. |
| `--checkpoint-every` | 250 000 |  | Save a resumable checkpoint every this many environment steps. |
| `--keep-checkpoints` | 2 |  | Number of periodic checkpoints kept (checkpoints at T_p, T_r and the end are always kept). |
| `--save-policy-snapshots` / `--no-save-policy-snapshots` | on |  | Save the policy at every evaluation (re-evaluation without retraining). |
| `--save-planner-buffer` / `--no-save-planner-buffer` | on |  | Export D_P at t = T_p to artifacts/planner_buffer.npz (needed by BC). |
